extractions.unit: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

scope_quotes: if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

extractions.unit: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26).

unit_attributes.summary: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of, and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of application.

extractions.unit: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant;

scope_quotes: if it still is a good likeness of the applicant
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when a photograph shows a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the submitted ID document, provided it is still a good likeness of the applicant.

unit_attributes.summary: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it remains a good likeness of the applicant.

extractions.unit: The photograph must be free of material damage:

scope_quotes: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to submitted passport photographs.
unit_attributes.action_quote: must be free of material damage
unit_attributes.summary: The passport photograph must be free of material damage.

extractions.unit: Material damage is any damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges) or impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes);

alternative_quotes: makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges)
impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes)
unit_attributes.choice_quote: makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges) or impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes)
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either damage that makes the photo no longer a good likeness, or damage in the area of the eyes that impedes facial recognition.
unit_attributes.summary: Material damage is defined as any damage to the facial area making the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, large smudges) or impeding facial recognition functioning (damage in the eye area).

extractions.unit: Immaterial damage is any damage to the background, and non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes).

alternative_quotes: non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes)
unit_attributes.choice_quote: any damage to the background, and non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes)
unit_attributes.choice_text: Damage to the background and non-material damage to the facial area.
unit_attributes.summary: Immaterial damage is defined as any damage to the background and non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes).

extractions.unit: Immaterial damage is acceptable;

unit_attributes.summary: Immaterial damage on a passport photograph is acceptable.

extractions.unit: The applicant does not need to sign the photograph, as this often causes creases or smudges; and

context_quotes: as this often causes creases or smudges
unit_attributes.summary: The applicant is not required to sign the photograph, as signing often causes creases or smudges.

scope_quotes: For hand-carry applications
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies exclusively to hand-carry applications.
unit_attributes.action: signing the back of the photograph
unit_attributes.summary: For hand-carry applications, the acceptance agent must sign the back of the photograph.

extractions.unit: Consequently, the passport application may be returned to adjudication to request a new photograph even though the photograph appeared acceptable.

scope_quotes: A photograph that appears acceptable and undamaged in the system may have a defect that is apparent when the passport is printed.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when a photograph appears acceptable and undamaged in the system but reveals a defect when the passport is printed.
unit_attributes.action_quote: may be returned to adjudication to request a new photograph
unit_attributes.action: returning the passport application to adjudication to request a new photograph
unit_attributes.summary: A passport application may be returned to adjudication to request a new photograph if a defect becomes apparent upon printing, even if the photograph previously appeared acceptable.

extractions.unit: Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons, e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes.

context_quotes: e.g., the applicant has recently had ocular surgery and the eyeglasses are necessary to protect the applicant’s eyes
unit_attributes.summary: Eyeglasses must not be worn in passport photographs unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons.

unit_attributes.summary: Eyeglasses are excepted from the ban when they cannot be removed for medical reasons (e.g., after recent ocular surgery when eyeglasses are necessary for eye protection).

extractions.unit: The applicant’s expression should be natural.
